name: Creator Link-in-Bio Email, Readiness Score & Brand-Deal Outreach Pipeline

parameters.content:
## Creator Link-in-Bio Email & Brand-Deal Outreach Pipeline (Zero-Proxy)

Reads creator Link-in-Bio URLs (Linktree, Beacons, Stan.store, Komi, Hoo.be, Bio.site, Carrd) from **Google Sheets**, extracts business/agency emails (including 1-hop deep contact & Media Kit follow), scores **Brand-Deal Readiness (0–100)**, separates no-email profiles into a manual follow-up tab, logs enriched creators to Google Sheets, and routes `VIP_AGENCY` creators to `#creator-partnerships` + Gmail pitch briefing while posting `DIRECT_READY` / `NURTURE` creators to `#influencer-ops`.

**Actor URL:** https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/creator-link-in-bio-email-enricher
**GitHub MCP & Kit:** https://github.com/wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
**Cost:** $2.50 / 1,000 creators · **$0 for filtered-out/no-email profiles** · 128–256 MB RAM · $0 proxy.

### 1. Creator Bio List Input (Google Sheets -> Deduplicated Batch)

Create a Google Sheet with three tabs:
- **`CreatorsInput`**: column `url` (e.g. `https://linktr.ee/averagefashionblogger`, `https://stan.store/stan`), optional `minReadinessScore` (default `40`).
- **`EnrichedCreators`**: columns `handle`, `displayName`, `outreachTier`, `creatorReadinessScore`, `platform`, `primaryEmail`, `emailType`, `emailSource`, `hasBrandDeals`, `hasAffiliateStorefront`, `hasMediaKit`, `socialCount`, `sourceUrl`, `enrichedAt`.
- **`NeedsManualFollowup`**: columns `handle`, `displayName`, `platform`, `sourceUrl`, `creatorReadinessScore`, `socialCount`, `enrichedAt`.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - 1. Creator Bio List Input

parameters.content:
### 2. Zero-Proxy Link-in-Bio Enricher & Email Gate

1. Create a free [Apify account](https://apify.com) and generate an API token (`Settings -> API & Integrations`).
2. Create an n8n **Header Auth** credential (`Name`: `Authorization`, `Value`: `Bearer <your_apify_token>`) and select it on **Enrich Creator Link-in-Bio via Apify**.
3. Profiles without a contact email route cleanly to `NeedsManualFollowup` so partnerships teams can DM them manually.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - 2. Link-in-Bio Enricher & Email Gate

parameters.content:
### 3. Readiness Tiering, Sheet Sync & Partnerships Routing

- **All contactable creators** are saved to `EnrichedCreators` in Google Sheets.
- **VIP_AGENCY** (`creatorReadinessScore >= 75`, agency email, or Media Kit) -> Slack `#creator-partnerships` + Gmail pitch briefing for team review.
- **DIRECT_READY** & **NURTURE** -> Slack `#influencer-ops`.
